name: Retail Sales
read: Headline +0.21% m/m (prior +0.83%), ex-auto +0.21% (prior +0.82%): sharp slowdown, no consensus found. YoY 6.82% (prior 6.57%) still firm. Slower consumption input to Q4 GDP; CARTS +1.0% ex-auto pointed higher, so it diverged.

reasons: no consensus available; surprise not assessed
